filter: ZONECODE IS NOT NULL AND ZONECODE NOT LIKE 'S-%' AND OBJECTID <> 289
notes: County layer; Shoreland overlay polygons (S-G, S-N) and null-code rows excluded. OBJECTID 289 (a very large A-1 polygon, ~353 sq mi) excluded because its geometry is invalid in the source; it is missing from this adapter until the county repairs it.
